home.faq_a1: TimeZone.tools is a free, privacy-first collection of time and date tools for remote workers, developers, and global teams. It includes a time zone converter, meeting planner, date difference calculator, countdown timer, and working days calculator. Everything runs in your browser — no account or signup needed.
home.faq_q2: Are all tools on TimeZone.tools completely free?
home.faq_a2: Yes. All tools on TimeZone.tools are 100% free with no subscriptions, no hidden fees, and no account required. The site is supported by non-intrusive advertising.
home.faq_q3: What time and date tools does TimeZone.tools offer?
home.faq_a3: TimeZone.tools offers 5 precision tools: a Time Zone Converter supporting 80+ cities, a Meeting Planner with a 24-hour visual grid, a Date Difference Calculator, a Countdown Timer with shareable links, and a Working Days Calculator with holiday exclusions.
home.faq_q4: Is my data private and secure on TimeZone.tools?
home.faq_a4: Yes. All calculations run entirely in your browser using the built-in JavaScript Intl API. No data you enter — dates, times, or event names — is ever sent to any server or stored anywhere. There are no accounts and no tracking of your inputs.
home.faq_q5: Does TimeZone.tools work without an account or registration?
home.faq_a5: Yes. TimeZone.tools requires no account, no email, and no registration of any kind. Simply open the tool you need and start using it immediately.
home.faq_a6: TimeZone.tools is fully translated into 7 languages: English, Arabic (with RTL layout), Turkish, French, Spanish, Hindi, and Chinese. Use the language switcher in the top navigation bar to change the language.

tz.page_description: Convert times between any cities and countries. Supports 80+ timezones worldwide.
tz.faq_q1: What is the best free time zone converter?
tz.faq_a1: TimeZone.tools offers a free, fast, and accurate time zone converter supporting 80+ cities worldwide. It uses the browser's built-in Intl API for precise DST-aware conversions with no signup required.
tz.faq_q2: How do I convert EST to PST?
tz.faq_a2: Select New York (EST/EDT) as the source timezone, enter your date and time, then add Los Angeles (PST/PDT) as a target timezone. The converted time will appear instantly.
tz.faq_q3: What time is 3pm UTC in New York?
tz.faq_a3: 3pm UTC is 11am EST (Eastern Standard Time) or 10am EDT during daylight saving time in New York. Use our converter with UTC as the source and New York as the target for accurate results.
tz.faq_q4: Does the converter account for Daylight Saving Time?
tz.faq_a4: Yes. The converter uses your browser's built-in timezone database (IANA/Intl API), which fully accounts for DST transitions for all regions that observe it.
tz.faq_q5: Can I convert time for multiple timezones at once?
tz.faq_a5: Yes. Add as many target timezones as you need using the 'Add Timezone' button. Each result updates in real time as you change the source date or time.
tz.faq_q6: How do I find the UTC offset for a specific city?
tz.faq_a6: The UTC offset for each timezone is shown directly next to the city name in our converter. Offsets vary by season in regions that observe Daylight Saving Time.

meet.page_description: Find the best meeting time across multiple time zones. Visual grid shows overlapping business hours.
meet.best_slots_title: Best meeting slots (all in business hours)
meet.no_overlap_desc: Consider using early morning or late afternoon slots shown in yellow below.
meet.faq_q1: How do I find the best meeting time across time zones?
meet.faq_a1: Add each participant's timezone and name. The grid highlights hours where everyone is within business hours (9am–6pm local time). Green means full overlap, yellow means partial, and red means no one is available.
meet.faq_q2: What is the best overlap between New York and London?
meet.faq_a2: New York (EST) is UTC-5 and London (GMT) is UTC+0. Their best overlap window is typically 2pm–5pm London time, which is 9am–12pm New York time.
meet.faq_q3: What time zones overlap with US, Europe, and Asia?
meet.faq_a3: Finding a single slot that works for all three major regions is very difficult. The most common compromise is early morning US East Coast time (8am–10am EST), which is 1pm–3pm London and 9pm–11pm in Singapore/Tokyo.
meet.faq_q4: How many participants can I add to the meeting planner?
meet.faq_a4: You can add up to 6 participants from different time zones. The grid shows individual availability alongside combined overlap status.
meet.faq_q5: Does the meeting planner account for Daylight Saving Time?
meet.faq_a5: Yes. The planner uses the Intl API with the current date, so all offsets are accurate for the current time of year including DST.

dateDiff.page_description: Calculate the exact number of days, weeks, months, and years between any two dates.
dateDiff.swapped_warning: End date is before start date — showing absolute difference.
dateDiff.faq_q1: How do I calculate the number of days between two dates?
dateDiff.faq_a1: Enter a start date and end date in the calculator above. The tool instantly shows the total number of days, weeks, months, and years between the two dates.
dateDiff.faq_q2: What is the difference between calendar days and working days?
dateDiff.faq_a2: Calendar days count every day of the week including weekends. Working days (also called business days) only count Monday through Friday, optionally excluding public holidays.
dateDiff.faq_q3: How many days until a specific date?
dateDiff.faq_a3: Set today as the start date and your target date as the end date. The result shows exactly how many days remain.
dateDiff.faq_q4: How many weeks are between two dates?
dateDiff.faq_a4: The date difference calculator shows full weeks as well as the remaining days. For example, 30 days = 4 weeks and 2 days.
dateDiff.faq_q5: Can I calculate how old I am in days?
dateDiff.faq_a5: Yes. Enter your birth date as the start date and today as the end date. The result shows your exact age in years, months, weeks, and days.

countdown.page_description: Count down to any date and time. Share your countdown with a unique link.
countdown.faq_q1: How do I create a countdown timer online?
countdown.faq_a1: Enter your target date and time, give it an event name, and the timer starts counting down immediately. You can share it with others using the Share button.
countdown.faq_q2: How do I share a countdown timer?
countdown.faq_a2: Click the Share button to copy a link. The target date is encoded in the URL, so anyone who opens it will see the same countdown.
countdown.faq_q3: How many days until New Year?
countdown.faq_a3: Use the 'New Year' preset button to instantly start a countdown to January 1st of next year.
countdown.faq_q4: Can I count down to a specific time of day?
countdown.faq_a4: Yes. Enter both the target date and time. The countdown shows days, hours, minutes, and seconds remaining.
countdown.faq_q5: What happens when the countdown reaches zero?
countdown.faq_a5: When the countdown reaches zero, the timer displays a completion message instead of counting negative.

workDays.page_description: Calculate the number of working days between two dates, excluding weekends and optional public holidays.
workDays.faq_q1: How do I calculate working days between two dates?
workDays.faq_a1: Enter a start and end date. The calculator counts all weekdays (Monday–Friday) in the range, optionally excluding public holidays.
workDays.faq_q2: How many working days are there in a year?
workDays.faq_a2: A typical year has around 260–262 working days (52 weeks × 5 days), minus public holidays. The exact count varies by country and year.
workDays.faq_q3: What counts as a working day?
workDays.faq_a3: A working day is any weekday (Monday through Friday) that is not a public holiday. Weekends (Saturday and Sunday) are always excluded.
workDays.faq_q4: How do I calculate a deadline excluding weekends?
workDays.faq_a4: Enter today as the start date and your deadline as the end date. The result shows how many working days remain, helping you plan project timelines.
workDays.faq_q5: Does the calculator account for public holidays?
workDays.faq_a5: Yes. Enable the 'Exclude public holidays' option to subtract major US, UK, and global holidays from the working day count.

about.page_subtitle: Free, precise time and date tools for remote workers, developers, and global teams. Built to be fast, private, and always available — no account required.
about.mission_p1: As the world becomes more connected, coordinating across time zones has become a daily challenge for millions of people. Whether you're scheduling a meeting with a team on three continents, counting down to a product launch, or calculating project deadlines — you need tools that are reliable, fast, and respect your privacy.
about.mission_p2: TimeZone.tools was built to solve these problems simply and efficiently. Every calculation runs entirely in your browser using the industry-standard IANA timezone database. Your data never leaves your device.
about.value_fast_desc: All calculations use the browser's built-in IANA timezone database for DST-accurate results.
about.value_private_desc: Everything runs in your browser. No data is ever sent to a server or stored anywhere.
about.value_global_desc: Available in 7 languages with full RTL support for Arabic speakers.
about.tech_p: TimeZone.tools is built as a pure client-side React application. There is no backend server, no database, and no user accounts. All timezone data comes from the browser's built-in Intl API powered by the IANA Time Zone Database.
